name: Rein Operations
description: Foundation operations extension; status, synthetic rehearsals and explicitly configured proposal tools, plus the database-backed Slack MVP slice for identity status, available funds, Contributor proposals and Board polls.

mvp.description: Database-backed Slack MVP slice: identity status and available funds reads, plus Contributor proposal submission, Board poll, ballot and result writes, and post-result feedback on a proposal that passed. One installation serves exactly one Slack workspace: OpenClaw tool context carries no team ID, so the team is fixed configuration. Enabling this block registers rein_mvp_my_status, rein_mvp_funds, rein_mvp_proposal_submit, rein_mvp_poll_open, rein_mvp_vote, rein_mvp_poll_result, rein_mvp_proposal_comment_suggest, rein_mvp_revision_approve and rein_mvp_revision_apply instead of the synthetic simulators and the legacy proposal tools. After a result the Board may still comment or suggest a revision on a proposal that passed. An ordinary revision of the title or the summary is accepted and made effective by the Agent itself, with no separate Board approval. A revision that moves budget, location, schedule, personnel or the major event flow is refused until a current director records an approval; schedule is material in the current implementation. Feedback is limited to the approved Board channel and to current directors, who are the voters; the database row also permits an active Contributor author. A recorded vote outcome, a comment, an approval and an applied revision never reserve, approve or pay money, and no tool posts a message.

enabled.description: Explicit opt-in. Nothing registers while this is false or absent.

platform.description: P0 uses exactly one chat platform; this slice is Slack-only.

slackTeamId.description: The one Slack team this installation serves, for example T01234567. Not a credential; never echoed to callers.

environment.description: Selects the dev_ or prod_ database table set. Required, with no implicit default.

proposalChannelIds.description: Approved native Slack channel IDs where a member may ask about their own status, and where an active Contributor may submit a proposal.

boardChannelIds.description: Approved native Slack channel IDs for the Board; funds reads, poll creation, ballots and results are limited to these channels and to current directors.

supabaseUrlEnvVar.description: Name of the server environment variable that holds the Supabase project URL. The value is read from the server process environment, never from this config.

supabaseServiceKeyEnvVar.description: Name of the server environment variable that holds the server-only Supabase key. The key is never stored in config, status, results or error messages.
